title: Consultor
description:
- Prospecção de clientes: identificar e abordar potenciais compradores, por meio de visitas, indicações, contatos telefônicos, redes sociais e outros canais de captação.

- Gestão de carteira: administrar a carteira de clientes ativos e potenciais, garantindo fidelização e novas indicações.

- Cumprimento de metas: atingir objetivos de vendas definidos pela empresa, mantendo alta performance e foco em resultados.

- Participação em treinamentos: atualizar-se constantemente sobre produtos, mercado e técnicas de vendas para aprimorar a atuação.

- Atuação estratégica: colaborar com a equipe e liderança na construção de ações de marketing e campanhas comerciais.

title: Assistente De Vendas
description:
Tarefas Auxiliar de Vendas

As tarefas de um auxiliar de vendas geralmente envolvem apoiar a equipe comercial e garantir que o processo de vendas seja mais ágil e organizado. Aqui estão as principais responsabilidades:

  • Atualizar planilhas e sistemas de CRM (cadastro de clientes, propostas, follow-ups).
  • Organizar documentos de vendas, contratos e orçamentos.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho (metas, resultados, pipeline).
  • Acompanhar envios considerando fretes e coleta por parte da transportadora.

Apoio Comercial

  • Auxiliar na elaboração de propostas comerciais.
  • Realizar cotações com fornecedores e validação de estoques.
  • Dar suporte ao time de vendas em apresentações ou reuniões.
  • Acompanhar status de negociações e prazos de entrega.

Atendimento ao Cliente

  • Atender clientes por telefone, e-mail ou WhatsApp.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre produtos, preços e prazos.
  • Encaminhar contatos para os vendedores responsáveis.
  • Fazer follow-up (acompanhamento) de propostas enviadas.

Organização e Logística

  • Controlar estoque de materiais de apoio (catálogos, brindes, amostras).
  • Acompanhar logística de entregas em conjunto com o setor responsável.
  • Garantir que os vendedores tenham materiais atualizados (catálogos, tabelas de preço).
  • Apoiar na organização do material que foi vendido.

    • Em resumo, o auxiliar de vendas não atua diretamente na negociação final, mas garante que os vendedores tenham informações, suporte e organização para focar nas vendas.

Como se candidatar:

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

Isso inclui uma gestão eficiente de leads de diversas fontes, um uso exemplar das ferramentas tecnológicas, e uma participação ativa na angariação de novos imóveis para a carteira. title: Network Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Network Analyst who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must have:

- Engineer or Technologist of systems or telecommunications, in computer science or related, with experience in management of local area networks (wired/wireless) for more 2000 virtual /physical devices and extended datacenter supporting critical business environments.

- Creation/Editing medium and high critical configuration scripts for new environments/ troubleshooting/ remediation scenario.

- Cisco CCNA Certification desirable.

- Experience for configuration, troubleshooting, testing, IMAC for access/border/core network for Cisco/HP Family.

- This Family comprises small/medium switches L2/L3, small/medium/large Router L3-L7 for access/edge/core, WLAN Cisco/HP

- This CoE wants coverage firewalls Palo Alto, SASE - apply policies/rules/group member/individual

- Identification, testing and built cabling CAT5-9, fiberoptics MM/SM

- Testing for data communication radio & mobile access

- Knowledge for NSX /Virtualization network

- Active Directory/ Radius/802.1x/ MFA authentication.

- Palo Alto Firewall / Windows Jump Server configuration.

- Palo Alto VPN.

- Panorama and Cortex Management for large number of devices.

- Prepare, validate and conduct change Management process.

- Capacity/Performance analysis (CPU, Mem, throughput ports).

- Good Communication skills.

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

.

Good to have:

- Cisco CCNA Certification desirable.

- Knowledge Fortinet/Huawei for network (LAN/WLAN) and security devices.

- Firewalls Paloalto and network security administration.

- Palo Alto Panorama and large number of firewall visibility and administration.

- Setup, configuration, integration, design, zero trust. Rules optimization, IP Policy and documentation

- Hardening, standard setup to prod preparation, capacity planning, high availability and failover

- Virtual and appliances devices, cloud and on prem, backup & Restore.

- VPN IPsec and Client to site implementation

- Integration with other security team members from threat intel, SOC

- Experience for EndUser support in record, diagnose and solve problems in the scope of microcomputing, hardware, operating systems, telephony, videoconferencing, web conferencing, audio conferencing and related areas, including performing any corrective maintenance on ICT equipment;

- Experience to clarify doubts and guide users regarding the use, availability, installation and configuration of software, applications, information systems (both those in the market and those developed internally), equipment, standards and procedures on the technological environment of the Customer and its use

- Identify and immediately report to the Level 2 Service Supervisor critical problems that have significant impacts on the technological environment of Customer, exceptional situations and other situations beyond its control or jurisdiction.

- Perform analysis of the hardware requirements for software installation.

- Test functionalities of new equipment, components or peripherals, and prepare configuration and user guides or manuals;

- Act in the execution of activities of the asset management process in Customer locations where there are no asset technicians allocated, at times when the Asset Management service is not available or whenever required by supervision.

- Understand cybersecurity attacks, mitigation methods.

Key responsibilities:

The network Associate is responsible for the LAN, WAN, WLAN or SDWAN Network. On LANs, WANs, WLANs, SDWANs, it is responsible for addressing, switches, routers, WiFi related devices, AD, DNS, NPM, Firewalls, CDN's, Balancers, NFV. In the WAN he is responsible for private networks and the Internet, and assists in the adoption of monitoring and data collection tools in the network. Supports carrier trunking with the local network, and participate on complex Network Setups.

What can you expect from us?

- Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

- Opportunities to work outside Brazil

- A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

description:

In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

  • Generous benefits package

title: Engenheiro De Controle
description:
About Woodgrove


We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.


Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.


All resumes must be in english.


Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.G., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.
  • Verification and validation of software through inspection, simulation, and testing
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and implement control systems for new projects.
  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.

We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .

A posição de Consultor(a) de Presidência tem como principal missão apoiar diretamente o(a) CEO na agenda estratégica, institucional e de governança da companhia, contribuindo para o desdobramento e acompanhamento dos principais pilares do plano estratégico, garantindo fluidez na tomada de decisões e na interlocução com os principais stakeholders da organização, incluindo o acionista francês.

  • Apoiar a presidência na consolidação da agenda estratégica da companhia, atuando como facilitador entre os objetivos corporativos e os principais desdobramentos executivos;
  • Preparar materiais executivos para conselhos, comitês e reuniões de acompanhamento estratégico, garantindo alinhamento institucional e consistência da informação;
  • Coordenar, junto à alta liderança, a governança de projetos estruturantes, assegurando visibilidade, integração e aderência aos objetivos do negócio;
  • Participar ativamente das interlocuções com o acionista estrangeiro, contribuindo com insumos estratégicos, apresentações e análises sobre a operação e seus resultados;
  • Monitorar os principais indicadores estratégicos da companhia, propondo leituras executivas, análises de sensibilidade e alertas para tomada de decisão;
  • Garantir uma visão integrada das informações gerenciais, consolidando dados de diversas áreas em diagnósticos estratégicos e dashboards de performance;
  • Atuar como braço estendido da presidência em iniciativas corporativas de alto impacto, com capacidade de articulação e influência junto a stakeholders internos e externos;

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.G. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.
You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.
Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information
The Team
Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.
As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Testing & Commissioning Engineer

This position demands a solid foundation in electrical engineering, particularly in testing and Commissioning power generation equipment. The ideal candidate will ensure that all equipment and systems adhere to Industry standards and regulatory requirements through thorough and safe testing processes. Responsibilities will encompass managing all aspects of testing, including Factory acceptance Tests (FAT), Site acceptance Tests (Sat), and Integrated Systems Tests (IST). The engineer should be proficient in developing and executing test plans That align with customer needs while maintaining clear communication with the factory.


Key responsibilities:

  • Actual participation in testing and commissioning activities including FAT, SAT, and IST;
  • Ensure adherence to industry regulations and safety standards during testing and commissioning processes;
  • Develop and implement testing protocols to validate system functionality and performance according to customer specificity;
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to testing and commissioning;
  • Collaborate with project teams to incorporate testing and commissioning activities into overall project plans;
  • Preparing project documentation, including test reports, commissioning plans, and equipment manuals;
  • Participate in project meetings and effectively communicate with stakeholders to achieve project goals.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field is preferred;
  • Proven experience in testing and commissioning power generator preferred;
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to electrical testing and commissioning (E.G., IEEE, IEC, NEC);
  • Strong troubleshooting abilities and capacity to analyze complex electrical systems;
  • Experience in project management or coordination is a plus;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to workindependently and as part of a team;
  • Strong commitment to safety and quality;
  • This position may require travel to project sites or customer locations, both locally and internationally as needed.

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
Business Operations Associate


São Paulo, Brazil

About Divibank:


At Divibank, we are developing the leading platform for online businesses in Latin America, combining

payment solutions and access to capital. With our payment orchestration solution, we integrate multiple

payment methods to our subacquirer, helping businesses increase transaction approvals and improve

their sales by up to 22%, reduce costs and drive sustainable growth. Our mission is to be the go-to

partner for companies looking to expand efficiently, offering technology and personalized support in an

all-in-one platform.


This is a PJ hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in our office on Av Brigadeiro Faria Lima 1912.


About the role and team:

We are looking for a Business Operations Associate to join our dynamic team.

You will have the opportunity to drive the success of businesses in Brazil and play a critical role in

ensuring smooth operational processes, providing exceptional customer support, and fostering strong

relationships with our clients. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and driven by

problem-solving. Our operations and customer success teams are the tip of the spear of our business,

with agile thinking and excellent communication to drive positive change for our customers.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the processes of proposal generation, KYC (Know Your Customer), and client

onboarding, ensuring agility and clear communication with all relevant teams.

  • Act as the main point of contact for customers, ensuring an efficient onboarding process,

addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive customer experience.

  • Oversee customer support operations using CX tools to triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets

quickly, delivering an exceptional customer experience that conveys trust and reliability.

  • Monitor transaction data and chargebacks, quickly identifying fraud risks and implementing

corrective actions.

  • Handle chargeback response cases, supporting clients to timely respond with the necessary

information.

  • Work together with our Treasury to ensure client settlements are working according to plan.
  • Run credit card receivable assignment operations, either for discounting or for collection

purposes.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies related to payment

operations.

  • Map and review operational workflows and data to identify gaps and propose improvements,

whether through process adjustments, the implementation of third-party tools, or development

suggestions for internal product and tech teams.

  • Collaborate with technology and product teams to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues in

a timely manner.

  • Proactively engage with customers to understand their needs and ensure their satisfaction with

our services.

  • Work closely with the sales and product teams to align customer success initiatives to optimize

customer journey

  • Track and report customer success metrics, including satisfaction rates, retention, and churn.


What qualifications we need:

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, customer success, or a related role, preferably within the

fintech, payments or consulting industries.

  • Bachelor’s degree (completed or in progress) in relevant fields (Business Administration,

Engineering, etc.).

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
  • Proficiency in using customer relationship management (CRM) and operations tools.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong sense of ownership and business orientation
  • Positive, willing to get hands dirty and proactive attitude
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize in ambiguous situations
  • Working proficiency and communication skills in English (verbal and written)


Nice to haves:

  • Experience in Fintech or online Payments industry
  • Basic understanding of APIs or technical architecture to collaborate effectively with engineers
  • Knowledge of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude or Looker.


Personal attitudes we look for:

  • You get sh*t done!
  • You do whatever it takes to get things moving and completed
  • You have an ownership mentality, are energetic, and bring the best out of others
  • You communicate clearly and concisely
  • You can adapt and explain complex subjects to different audiences
  • Everyone understands what your priorities and objectives are
  • You organize and break down complex problems into simple tasks
  • You can think structurally and identify bottlenecks
  • You balance and align your short and long-term priorities with Divibank’s goals
  • You are curious and have a growth mindset
  • You are always learning and growing (even outside of work)
  • You take risks, learn from failures quickly and apply lessons learned
  • You are quietly confident and openly humble
  • You are confident in your abilities, and are not afraid to step up when needed
  • You respect the backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking of others


Key Benefits:

  • Amil Health and dental insurances
  • Competitive salary
  • Chance of earning equity at Divibank
  • Flexible paid vacation
  • Totalpass

title: Executivo De Vendas Externa - Mercado Pago
description:

Requisitos:

job context

and purpose


Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.

  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material

  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met


job

title: Leader-Merchant Informatization
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.
  2. Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  3. Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.
  4. Team Collaboration: Work closely with sales, compliance, and product teams to streamline the onboarding process and meet merchant needs.
  5. Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.


Job Requirements

  1. Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.

  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

description:
Comece aqui. Veja onde pode chegar.


Curitiba - PR


No Electrolux Group, uma empresa líder global no segmento de eletrodomésticos, nós buscamos todos os dias transformar a vida para o melhor para os nossos consumidores, nossos colaboradores, e nosso planeta. Nós compartilhamos ideias e perspectivas para, juntas e juntos, podermos desenvolver soluções que entreguem uma vida mais agradável e sustentável.


Venha e junte-se a nós como você é, porque acreditamos que pontos de vista diversos nos tornam mais fortes e inovadores. Dentro da nossa comunidade global com pessoas de mais de cem países, nós ouvimos uns aos outros, e ativamente colaboramos e crescemos em diversidade e inclusão.


Junte-se a nós na nossa incrível missão de construir a casa do futuro!


Tudo sobre a função:


Aqui no Electrolux Group, nós vamos muito mais além da melhoria contínua, e isso inclui desafiar nossos próprios processos de trabalho. Por todo o mundo, e por muitas plantas e setores, nossas equipes multifuncionais estão trabalhando proativamente para otimizar o potencial de nosso sistema de manufatura. Atuando de maneira dinâmica, ágil e focada na satisfação do consumidor, as nossas equipes de Produção contribuem para garantir que a Electrolux continue na vanguarda da inovação em produtos e serviços.


O que você vai fazer:


Seu maior desafio será liderar o time de operadores de Manufatura, garantindo os recursos necessários para o atendimento da programação de produção diária sem perder o foco na segurança de sua equipe e nos elevados padrões de qualidade da Electrolux. Se você tem boa capacidade de organização e análise, facilidade para se comunicar e colaborar, e consegue unir a sua visão estratégica com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa, essa é a sua chance! Ajude a Electrolux a continuar entregando experiências extraordinárias, e nós vamos te ajudar a voar muito mais alto.


Algumas responsabilidades serão:


- Treinar os membros da equipe, capacitando eles para suas funções conforme as metodologias e procedimentos internos da empresa;

- Continuamente buscar a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria, a fim de obter melhores resultados;

- Atuar na prevenção de acidentes de trabalho, monitorando o seguimento das Regras de Ouro de Segurança;

- Motivar a equipe, reduzindo o absenteísmo e o turnover de funcionários, e melhorando os resultados de Segurança, Qualidade, Entrega, Custo e Pessoas, sempre assegurando que todos estão trabalhando de acordo com os valores da Electrolux;

- Utilizar o EMS (Sistema de Manufatura Electrolux), baseado nas ferramentas e princípios de Lean Manufacturing.


Como parte da cultura de melhoria contínua, você participará de projetos e atividades de Lean Thinking (EMS / EAI).


Quem é você:


Você tem:


- Superior Completo e/ou Pós-Graduação, preferencialmente em Engenharia ou áreas Tecnológicas voltadas à indústria ou afins;

- Experiência em liderança e gestão de equipes (mínimo de 30 pessoas);

- Experiência comrotinas e processos de linha de produção e/ou montagem de produtos;

- Experiência em projetos de melhoria contínua com base na aplicação das técnicas e princípios do Lean Manufacturing;

- Conhecimento nas ferramentas da indústria 4.0;

- Desejável experiência e conhecimento em legislações aplicáveis em gestão de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente em empresas de grande porte;

- Pacote Office intermediário;

- Desejável Inglês intermediário.


Onde você vai estar:


Você vai atuar em uma das plantas da Electrolux em Curitiba que funcionam como base para equipes de produção completamente focadas em transformar a vida para o melhor através da excelência no trabalho.


Com o compromisso de criar uma cultura inclusiva e de cuidado com o bem-estar de todos, oferecemos os seguintes benefícios:


- Descontos nos produtos e serviços da Electrolux;

- Plano de saúde e seguro de vida;

- Licença parental estendida (6 meses de licença maternidade, 4 semanas de licença paternidade);

Como parte do Electrolux Group, vamos investir continuamente em você e no seu desenvolvimento. Não existem barreiras para onde sua carreira pode te levar.

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.G., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role;
experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.G., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Supervisor De Produção
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO


Em modalidade de turno: Responsável pela gestão e atividades relacionadas ao processo produtivo na planta em que atua, supervisionando todas as etapas, provendo recursos e monitorando as necessidades de manutenções, sejam preventivas ou corretivas, atendendo os requisitos de qualidade e concentrando o time em temas e rotinas de segurança. Suportar e prover recursos para a equipe de forma a garantir a eficiência da operação e o atingimento dos resultados operacionais, bem como difundir rotinas de gestão da área cascateadas ao nível de turno como Manutenção Autônoma, requisitos do AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) e demais requisitos e acordos repassados pela gerência imediata ou corporação.


Em modalidade administrativa: Responsável pela gestão e atividades da área produtiva, supervisionando processos, rotinas e cumprimentos de padrões, servindo de ponto focal e de apoio ao gerente de produção na propagação de conhecimentos, recursos, desenvolvimentos e monitoramentos necessários para execução das rotinas da área. Suporta também o Gerente de Produção em rotinas administrativas da área como reuniões de planejamentos, demandas corporativas, estratégias de melhoria de resultados e sistema de gestão (AMPS).


RESPONSABILIDADES

Em modalidade de turno:

  • Conhecer, proceder e assegurar que as Políticas da Empresa, no que diz respeito a preservação do meio ambiente, prevenção na gestão de riscos e normas de saúde e segurança do trabalho;
    qualidade do produto;
    segurança de alimentos (FSSC 22.000);
    código de ética;
    compliance;
    recursos humanos;
    missão, visão e valores da empresa, buscando o alinhamento da conduta à estratégia/objetivos estabelecidos da Empresa e garantir que sejam cumpridos pela equipe.
  • Atuar conforme os procedimentos vigentes relacionados a gestão de mudança sendo responsável pelo reporte, divulgação, plano de ação e comunicação junto a equipe.
  • Supervisionar e prover recursos para a execução das rotinas da operação, por meio do monitoramento das manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos equipamentos, controle do volume de produção e tipo de rótulo a ser produzido.
  • Realizar a abertura e fechamento das Ordens de Produção, de Manutenção e consumos de materiais necessários para organização das rotinas produtivas.
  • Tomar decisões relacionadas ao processo produtivo, baseadas em análise de dados técnicos e estatísticos para garantir a assertividade da decisão.
  • Direcionar as ações para minimizar as perdas no processo produtivo, aumentar a eficiência operacional e controlar o consumo de insumos.
  • Garantir a execução dos planos de ação e diretrizes da área na busca do atingimento das metas e resultados operacionais.
  • Supervisionar as atividades de retrabalho de produtos fora de especificação de modo adequá-los ao padrão de qualidade, bem como em processos de repacking.
  • Facilitar a comunicação e disseminação das informações corporativas entre a equipe.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe de acordo com a matriz de competência avaliando as necessidades individuais de treinamento e atendendo aos prazos definidos pela corporação.
  • Realizar a avaliação de desempenho da equipe, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, mapeamento as forças e oportunidades de cada colaborador para elaboração do plano de desenvolvimento individual e retenção de talentos.
  • Realizar feedbacks, promovendo o desenvolvimento de cada colaborador em alinhamento às estratégias e valores da empresa.
  • Executar atividades técnicas e administrativas ligadas a gestão de pessoas, tais como: recrutamento e seleção, integração de novos colaboradores, plano e controle de execução dos treinamentos, ajuste do ponto eletrônico, planejamento de férias, medidas disciplinares e desligamento.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável para o engajamento da equipe e melhores resultados.
  • Praticar o conceito de “Melhoria Contínua” no processo, implementando melhorias de segurança e qualidade, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as práticas de housekeeping.
  • Atuar no AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) liderando equipes e grupos internos em todas as iniciativas necessárias conformes demandas da gerência imediata ou corporativa.
  • Comunicar a gerência imediata qualquer problema que ocorra no processo produtivo, bem como seguir o fluxo de comunicação definido na planta para envolvimento de outras áreas, quando necessário e aplicável.
  • Comunicar, treinar, acompanhar e tratar quaisquer questões de segurança do time e da área, a fim de preservar integridade física dos colaboradores e aderência do time operacional à cultura e iniciativas na área de EHS.
  • Disponibilizar e gerenciar recursos como gestões visuais, ferramentas e outros juntamente com o time operacional afim de garantir que se mantenha disponibilizado e em bom estado de conservação todos os recursos disponibilizados para correta execução das atividades.
  • Analisar e montar plano estratégico em caso de desvios de resultados de produção, qualidade, segurança e manutenção, apresentando em reuniões solicitadas e acompanhando o ciclo para garantir correto cumprimento de ações estabelecidadas, por si ou por outros.


Em modalidade administrativa, além de saber realizar e monitorar os mencionados acima para turno, deve:

  • Monitorar o plano de produção, a fim de conciliar as demandas corporativas para atendimento ao cliente com as necessidades locais da planta, montando estratégias de atendimento por módulo e por tipos de produto.
  • Realizar gestões de rotinas, criando e acompanhando indicadores a fim de suportar a execução das rotinas operacionais pelos times operacionais de turno de maneira correta, conforme padrões estabelecidos para cada atividade.
  • Suportar o gerente de produção, por sua solicitação ou ausência, em rotinas administrativas como reuniões corporativas e locais, demandas pontuais ou rotineiras, seja nos temas de segurança, qualidade, produção, manutenção, rh, bem como qualquer outro tema definido que alinhe a área aos requisitos definidos pela organização.
  • Realizar a gestão de KPIs da área já definidos pela companhia visando atingimento de metas e resultados.
  • Ser um facilitador de informações e conhecimento na área, treinando ou suportando os supervisores de turno envolvendo a todos nos temas necessários para a área produtiva.
  • Realizar trabalhos/análises estratégicas para a área, de forma mais abrangente e sistêmica comparando ao supervisor de turno, visando melhoria de resultados e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de Produção na condução da Manutenção Autônoma na área produtiva.
  • Participar da implementação de Trials da área, quando solicitado, e repassar informações e direcionamentos aos turnos.
  • Liderar projetos na área produtiva, sejam esses definidos pela gerência local ou corporativa. Ex.: Plant of the Future (PoF).
  • Garantir que as rotinas de reuniões da área produtiva ocorram com o envolvimento correto das pessoas necessárias para boa condução e atingimento dos objetivos.


Formação

Superior completo


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Pacote Office;
  • Liderança de Equipes (com experiência prévia);
  • Análise e Interpretação de Dados;
  • Conhecimento emindicadores de performance (Produção e Manutenção);
  • Conhecimento e habilidade com processos produtivos;
  • Conhecimento emauditorias e processos de certificações;
  • Habilidade de interpretação e consulta dos manuais técnicos dos equipamentos.
  • Sistemas ERP: SAP;
  • Lean Manufacturing / TPM / WCM ou correlatos;
  • Conhecimento emprocessos de Estampagem / Corte e repuxo (Prensas);
  • Idioma: Inglês Intermediário ou Avançado.


Sobre a Ardagh:


A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!


Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.


Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

title: Senior Benefits Manager Latam
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.G., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.G., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

Principais Tarefas:

Realizar impressão da agenda do dia seguinte afim, de fazer um levantamento dos procedimentos a serem enviados ao laboratório;

Efetuar baixa no sistema de gestão referente aos materiais recebidos do laboratório;

Realizar controle de prontuários na clínica;

Colocar os prontuários do dia sobre a bancada por ordem de atendimento;

Atenção ao paciente

Realizar o acolhimento do paciente nos serviços de saúde bucal;

Preparar o paciente para o atendimento;

Fazer checklist para realizar a separação dos materiais e instrumentos clínicos a serem utilizados pelo dentista nas cirurgias;

Auxiliar e instrumentar os profissionais nas intervenções clínicas;

Organizar os consultórios diariamente verificando se os materiais e ambientes estão de acordo para atender os pacientes;

Executar limpeza, assepsia, desinfecção e esterilização do instrumental, equipamentos odontológicos e do ambiente de trabalho;

Abastecer sempreos consultórios com os materiais do dia-a-dia sugador, resina, babador, entre outros;

Zelar pela boa manutenção de aparelhos e peças;

Aplicar medidasde biossegurança no armazenamento, transporte, manuseio e descarte de produtos e resíduos odontológicos;

Manipular materiais de uso odontológicos zelando para que o estoque esteja sempre abastecido;

Realizar controle de componentes de prótese e implantes;

Adotar medidas de biossegurança visando controle de contaminação.

Determinações Internas Utilizar uniforme e crachá adequadamente, mantendo sua apresentação pessoal e da empresa;

Utilizar corretamente os EPI's recomendados para a realização segura das tarefas de trabalho conforme os procedimentos relacionados à atividade exercida;

Cumprir as determinações que constam no Modelo de Negócio da Franqueadora.

Formação Escolaridade: Técnico de Saúde Bucal ou Auxiliar Odontológico e possuir registro no CRO.

Conhecimentos: Assepsia e Antissepsia;

Assepsia:

É o conjunto de medidas para evitar a contaminação de um ambiente ou material por microrganismos.

Antissepsia:

É o uso de substâncias (antissépticos) para reduzir ou eliminar microrganismos em tecidos vivos, como pele e mucosas.


Conhecimento do instrumental e materiais utilizados no atendimento clínico;

Experiência anterior: Auxiliar de Dentista, Auxiliar Odontológico.

MANUAL DE RECURSOS HUMANOS

Ato de Servir: A essência de servir ao próximo, está ligada à nossa missão de prestar Atendimento Humanizado, aquele se dispõe a servir, facilita da vida de quem está sendo servido e engrandece a sua própria através do ato de bondade e generosidade.

Organização: Manter sempre ambientes organizados, para que sempre esteja fácil quando precisar de próteses ou instrumentos, etc.

Responsabilidade: Buscar manter-se atenta a prazos, sendo responsável pelas entregas de laboratórios.

Dinamismo: Atender pacientes de maneira dinâmica e clara, ser dinâmico é conseguir agregar a capacidade de raciocínio rápido e ser ágil no atendimento.

Simpatia: Fator crucial no atendimento para fidelizar nosso paciente a sua imagem é de extrema importância ela está atrelada a imagem da empresa, então ser simpática é um ponto positivo todos gostam de ser bem tratados.

Necessário: Curso de ASB ou Técnico de Saúde Bucal completo ou em andamento e ou experiência na área.
