title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office;
    CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.


Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Integration Solution-Team Leader
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management & Goal Achievement: Oversee daily operations and team management of the integration solution group, allocate resources reasonably, and lead the team to achieve goals in system integration, product optimization, and customer support.
  2. Integration Project Coordination & Delivery: Lead the planning, implementation, and delivery of integration projects involving external API service providers, hardware devices (such as printers), and internal systems, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
  3. Technical Solution Design & Optimization: Analyze customer and business needs, coordinate with technical teams to implement system connectivity, process optimization, and new feature development, continuously improving the quality and stability of overall integration solutions.
  4. Quality & Process Control: Establish and optimize team collaboration, product testing, launch processes, and integration standards;
    monitor key indicators to ensure high-standard deliverables.
  5. Complex Problem Solving & Technical Challenges: Lead the team to analyze and resolve complex technical issues in project integration and device operation, promote targeted technical solutions, and ensure successful client implementation.
  6. Cross-Departmental Communication & Collaboration: Act as the core liaison within the team, work closely with sales, technical, product, and operation teams to coordinate project progress and improve business synergy.
  7. Team Development & Capability Building: Develop and organize systematic training and growth plans for team members, continuously identify and cultivate talents, and build a high-performing and cohesive team.
  8. Industry Trend Insights & Innovation: Stay updated on order-taking solution development in the restaurant/merchant industry, including APIs, hardware, and apps;
    drive innovation in integration solutions and lead the professional advancement of the team.


Job Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Information Management, E-commerce, or related fields.
  2. At least 3 years of experience in technical integration, system implementation, product operations, or related team management, with a preference for experience in large-scale API, hardware, or integrated solution project management.
  3. Strong technical solution analysis, design, and optimization abilities;
    able to systematically solve complex technical and business problems.
  4. Familiar with API interfaces, hardware products (such as printers), apps, and various integration methods;
    deep understanding of overall solutions for the merchant industry is a plus.
  5. Outstanding cross-team communication, coordination, and project management skills;
    able to drive collaboration and achieve project goals.
  6. Ability to organize team training and development, nurture talent, and build a high-performing team.
  7. Results-oriented, highly resilient, and self-driven, with awareness of process optimization and high-standard quality control.
  8. Native-level Portuguese and strong proficiency in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing);
    able to communicate efficiently in an international and diverse environment. 9.Experience in restaurant/merchant integration projects or industry solution operations is a plus.


Job Highlights

  1. Early-Stage Business: Opportunity to participate in early-stage planning, design, and implementation of team and projects, driving core technology and product innovation.
  2. International Team: Work with colleagues from 26 countries, experience a diverse and open work environment, and expand your global perspective.

title: Workday Recruiting And Talent Analyst

As a key member of our Workday Application Management Support team, the Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst will own the configuration, maintenance, and support of our Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.

You will partner closely with HR and Talent Acquisition Teams to ensure Workday solutions align with evolving business needs, legal / regulatory requirements, and employee experience goals.

  • Ensure data accuracy and process scalability by preparing, loading, and validating EIBs for mass data updates.
  • Maximize system performance and adoption by evaluating new Workday releases, identifying relevant enhancements, and recommending high-impact improvements to stakeholders.
  • Ensure system reliability and business continuity by proactively monitoring health and resolving issues across Recruiting and Talent modules.
  • Improve transparency and knowledge sharing by maintaining clear, user-friendly documentation for configurations, business processes, and system policies.
  • Accelerate continuous improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration with analysts, IT teams, HR, Talent Acquisition and business stakeholders, delivering enhancements that add value and reduce manual effort.
  • Safeguard data integrity and compliance by ensuring configurations align with internal governance, audit requirements, and security standards.
  • Enhance user confidence and self-service adoption by contributing to the development of end-user training materials in partnership with HR.



Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience, with expertise in Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.
  • Strong understanding of HR and Recruiting policies.
  • Experience with Workday business processes, security roles related to Recruiting, Talent, and change management.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in EIBs and data management within Workday.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to translate technical configurations to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and process integrity.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver quality results in a fast-paced environment.

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: Reporter
description:
Risk Event-Driven Distressed (REDD) Intelligence is looking for a reporter to cover corporates in Brazil out of our office in Sao Paulo.

The reporter will have a notable track record covering and breaking news and a solid understanding of the corporate credit space, working closely with our experienced team of financial reporters and analysts to cover performing/distressed corporates in Brazil.


Day-to-day activities include:


  • Breaking news on corporate finance and operations, turnarounds and restructurings, legal, regulatory and market developments affecting Brazilian issuers
  • Working closely with our market-leading team of reporters and analysts across the global emerging markets
  • Analysis of finance, economics, legal situations and other data affecting corporates under coverage


Requirements:


  • A minimum three to five years’ experience with coverage of Brazil’s corporate space
  • A deep network of contacts in the business, asset management, banking, and legal communities
  • Knowledge of the corporate bond market and global/onshore credit
  • Facility with financial data and analysis related to coverage of the corporate space
  • Knowledge of the local dynamics affecting corporates under coverage
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a deadline-driven, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent English language writing skills


About REDD:


REDD produces real-time news and analysis on emerging market corporate and sovereign event-driven special situations, helping asset managers, bankers, and advisers assess opportunities in the high-yield and high-grade markets.

REDD is a strong proponent of gender and racial diversity, and an equal opportunity employer. We are a motivated team of free thinkers and expect our team members to be personable and dynamic, encouraging “out of the box” thinking and the ability to discuss and appreciate different points of view to avoid the blind spots presented by group think.

We can offer you an opportunity to pursue a challenging but rewarding career with ample progression within a diverse international organisation. We also offer a market-leading competitive salary package and flexible working arrangements.

Headquartered in London with bureaus across the global emerging markets, REDD Intelligence’s team is made up of professionals with investment banking, legal and financial reporting experience, leveraging regional relationships to report on catalysts related to a universe of over 3,500 companies and sovereigns under coverage.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

Todos os dias, buscamos fornecer soluções para alguns dos maiores desafios do mundo - como educação, saúde, energia, água, transporte, habitação e saneamento.


Odebrecht & Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência:

Acreditamos que a pluralidade e o conhecimento técnico potencializam a nossa força, aprimoram as nossas entregas e impactam nos resultados.

Para a Odebrecht, a inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência no ambiente empresarial presume uma postura ativa pela garantia de direitos humanos, com respeito e valorização das diferenças em todas as suas dimensões, reconhecendo também a multiplicidade humana, em todas as suas formas, como fator de inovação, produtividade e performance.

title: Controller Sika Brazil
description:
Company Description
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 102 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector toward greater environmental compatibility. With more than 34,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.76 billion in 2024.
Job Description
The role is responsible for overseeing financial planning, organization, and management, ensuring the accurate recording and preparation of financial statements. It includes monitoring and controlling all economic transactions to guarantee proper administration of the company’s resources, while ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation, Sika Group policies, and best practices in financial management. Additionally, the position applies advanced techniques, tools, and operational procedures to drive efficiency and effectiveness across all financial processes.
Specific Tasks
  • Define the financial policy to be followed by the Company, in consultation and agreement with superiors.
  • Budget cash flow and determine critical moments.
  • Ensure and supervise the generation of reports to General Management and the corporate channel (Regional and Headquarters).
  • Arrange for internal audits, periodic inventory counts, etc.
  • Supervise the calculation process of standard costs for the Company's various products.
  • Control compliance with tax and labor obligations.
  • Advise General Management on matters within their professional scope.
  • Train, promote, and motivate their staff.
  • Identify needs and develop the training plan for their area, submitting it to the HR Department.
  • Know, comply with, and help disseminate the policies of the Integrated Management System, regarding Quality Management, Occupational Health and Safety, and Responsible Environmental Care of the Company.
Qualifications
Educational and Attitudinal Competencies
  • Formal education: Degree in Administration, Economics, or Public Accounting. Preferably with postgraduate training in Administration or equivalent.
  • MBA, specialized in finance, or other postgraduate studies relevant to the role.
  • Special courses: Proficiency in PC and operating systems. Financial updates. Knowledge of ISO 9001 and 14001 standards. Knowledge of accounting standards (GAAP).
  • Advanced English
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years in similar positions in medium or large companies.
  • Strong critical, reflective, and analytical capacity.
  • High level of concentration, speed, and accuracy in mathematical calculations.
  • Quick and confident decision-making.
  • Good interpersonal skills. Firm and responsible character.
  • Willingness to travel nationally and internationally on a regular basis.

description:

COFCO International is a global agribusiness company that purchases, stores, sells, processes, and distributes essential agricultural commodities: grains, oilseeds, sugar, cotton, and coffee.

Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, COFCO International employs approximately 11,000 professionals in 37 countries and has assets on every continent, with operations in more than 50 countries.

COFCO International is an agribusiness platform of COFCO Corporation, one of China's largest agricultural and food companies, with global operations.


About the position:

Responsible for COFCO's transactional processes in the areas of Accounting, Tax Calculation, Tax Receipts, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Service Contracts, Freight, and Consumer Account Management, ensuring process efficiency through compliance with the area's KPIs and SLAs.


Main responsibilities:

Develop and implement effective strategies for the SSC, aligned with the objectives of each business;

Identify and implement continuous improvements in SSC processes and systems, with the aim of increasing efficiency and reducing costs;

Collaborate with other functional areas and business leaders to ensure efficient service delivery;

Manage the calculation of federal, state, and municipal taxes, with the aim of collecting debts and/or refunding tax benefits in accordance with current legislation. Ensure compliance with ancillary obligations within the established deadlines;

Ensure the control of service contracts, leases, and similar agreements, from the receipt of the supply process to the termination of the contract;

Manage COFCO's financial control involving Accounts Payable and Receivable operations, ensuring write-offs and controls and advances made to suppliers, following established policies;

Responsible for ensuring all COFCO Freight and Transit operations, from contracting services to accurate entries and payments;

Responsible for seeking efficiency in SSC operations through SLAs agreed with each business leader;

Ensure the accounting reconciliation of COFCO INTL companies in Brazil, aiming to comply with accounting standards and in line with global Controllership guidelines;

Ensure compliancewith the budget and manage expenses under your management, in line with company policies and departmental objectives;

Promote continuous improvement and automation of processes under your management and implement the necessary controls to mitigate risks and losses for the company;

Responsible for complying with current laws and internal procedures and being the point of reference;

Seek to unify andstandardize transaction processes for the SSC.


Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

MBA/Postgraduate degree – Controllership, Financial Management, and People Management;

More than 7 yearsof experience in SSC is required;

Work experience in a multinational company in a matrix environment and in the agribusiness sector;

Solid knowledge of accounting, financial management, calculations, internal control, reports, and financial processes;

Fluency in English;

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint);

Experience with the SAP system;

Experience with SLAs and KPIs;

Strong project and process management skills;

Experience with AI and automation, bringing innovative solutions to the business;

Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement;

Must have a strong ability to interact effectively with different hierarchical levels;

Effective management and leadership skills with strong verbal and written communication skills;

Proven experiencein leading teams in the Shared Services Center area;

Willingness to live and work in the city of São José do Rio Preto.


Please send your resume in English.


COFCO International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified talent is welcome and considered for our positions, regardless of race or ethnicity, religious belief, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, nationality, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.


Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.

  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.


Qualificações & requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte deliderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;


Competências comportamentais:


  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidadeanalítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação pararesultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;


Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. title: Government Relations Director, Brazil
description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumers


in more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and

lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help

everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their

individuality through access to the latest trends.


SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.


Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.


In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.


Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms


Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese;
    Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Assistente De Contas A Pagar
description:
Resumo da Função

Buscamos um Analista de Contas a Pagar que eleve o padrão financeiro da Marjom. Alguém rigoroso com detalhes, rápido na execução, dono das entregas e capaz de sustentar um fluxo sólido entre fábrica, fornecedores e diretoria. É uma cadeira estratégica para garantir previsibilidade, controle e saúde financeira.

Responsabilidades

  • Executar todo o fluxo de contas a pagar: conferência, classificação, programação e pagamentos.
  • Validar notas fiscais, boletos, retenções e impostos obrigatórios (ISS, INSS, IR, PIS/COFINS/CSLL).
  • Controlar vencimentos e montar a previsão de pagamentos semanal e mensal.
  • Realizar conciliações bancárias diárias e garantir acuracidade dos saldos.
  • Alimentar e atualizar planilhas e dashboards financeiros, assegurando consistência dos dados.
  • Manter relacionamento claro e profissional com fornecedores, negociando prazos quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar o fluxo de aprovação interna (diretoria, controladoria e demais áreas).
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas com documentação organizada e rastreável.
  • Contribuir para melhorias de processo, automatizações e aumento de eficiência.

Qualificações Técnicas

  • Experiência sólida em contas a pagar, financeiro ou controladoria.
  • Domínio de Excel/Google Sheets (PROCV/XLOOKUP, Tabela Dinâmica, fórmulas de análise).
  • Conhecimento de ERPs — desejável experiência com sistemas de indústria.
  • Entendimento de rotinas fiscais e contábeis.
  • Capacidade de montar previsões de fluxo de caixa e análises de variações.
  • Organização extrema e atenção a detalhes — nada passa despercebido.
  • Visão numérica forte e conforto com grandes volumes de dados.

Competências Interpessoais

  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e madura — sabe explicar problemas e alternativas.
  • Postura de dono: assume, resolve e entrega no prazo.
  • Agilidade e capacidade de priorizar em cenários de pressão.
  • Relacionamento respeitoso e colaborativo com times internos e fornecedores.
  • Disciplina e constância — mantém o ritmo mesmo em semanas críticas.
  • Curiosidade e mentalidade de melhoria contínua.
  • Alta confiabilidade e ética — lida com informações sensíveis diariamente.

Como este cargo se encaixa na Marjom

Esta função sustenta a operação financeira da empresa e é peça-chave para tomada de decisão. O Analista de Contas a Pagar garante previsibilidade, protege caixa, fortalece relações com fornecedores e cria uma base segura para o crescimento da companhia.

Presencial no Centro de São Leopoldo/RS - Próximo a Estação São Leopoldo

ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Trabalho Ativo (Vendas B2B e B2C);

  • Energia e ambição acima da média;

Venha ser LOBO!

Então essa é a sua chance!

A função do Production Executive abrange todos os estágios da produção de um banco de dados TGI típico, desde o ponto de criação do questionário online no PTK até a entrega final do banco de dados Choices. O Production Executive está envolvido em todos os procedimentos necessários para configurar questionários online, dicionários de banco de dados, importação e manuseio de dados usando o software de processamento de dados TGI - Publishers Toolkit (PTK).   • Ter bom conhecimento geral dos processos de construção de pesquisas e ter boa compreensão das metodologias de pesquisa usadas para TGI.
  • Criação do questionário online no PTK.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em projetos ad hoc.
  • Manter os KPIs de Desempenho de Negócios na Entrega de Serviços e Qualidade do Produto.

Essencial:

  • Experiência em processamento e análise de dados.

  • Conhecimento de metodologia de pesquisa.
  • Inglês - nivel intermediário.

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação

title: Inspetor De Qualidade
description:
1. Missão do Cargo


Garantir que produtos, processos e materiais atendam aos requisitos especificados pela empresa, clientes e normas aplicáveis, por meio de inspeções, registros e monitoramentos sistemáticos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade.


⸻


2. Principais Responsabilidades

- Realizar inspeções de recebimento, processo e produto final, conforme procedimentos e planos de inspeção.

- Registrar e manter atualizados os resultados das inspeções nos formulários, sistemas ou relatórios definidos.

- Identificar, segregar e registrar materiais ou produtos não conformes, comunicando aos responsáveis.

- Apoiar na investigação de não conformidades, realizar análises preliminares e sugerir ações corretivas/ver preventivas.

- Acompanhar testes e ensaios, garantindo que sejam cumpridos os requisitos técnicos.

- Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores da qualidade.

- Cumprir e fazer cumprir os procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (ISO 9001 ou outros aplicáveis).

- Sugerir melhorias nos processos, produtos e métodos de inspeção.


⸻


3. Competências Técnicas

- Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos (quando aplicável).

- Uso de instrumentos de medição e inspeção.

- Conhecimento básico/intermediário da ISO 9001.

- Registro e controle de não conformidades.

- Noções de ferramentas da qualidade (5S, diagrama de causa e efeito, PDCA, etc.).


⸻


4. Competências Comportamentais

- Atenção aos detalhes.

- Organização e disciplina nos registros.

- Comunicação clara e objetiva.

- Proatividade e foco em melhoria contínua.

- Imparcialidade e postura ética.

- Trabalho em equipe.


⸻


5. Formação e Experiência

- Ensino médio completo (técnico em qualidade ou áreas afins é diferencial).

- Experiência prévia em inspeção ou controle de qualidade.

- Desejável conhecimento em metrologia.

- Treinamentos específicos conforme a área de atuação (ex.: inspeção visual, instrumentos, processo produtivo).


⸻


6. Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)

- Taxa de retrabalho.

- Acuracidade de inspeção.

- Registros realizados dentro do prazo.

- Redução de não conformidades internas e externas.

- Cumprimento dos procedimentos de qualidade.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • Atleast 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: Desenvolvedor De Software Sênior
description:
A Paybyrd é uma plataforma global de pagamentos omnichannel , com presença em Rio de Janeiro , São Paulo e Lisboa . focada em ajudar empresas a oferecer experiências de pagamento modernas, simples e sem fricção – online e presencialmente. A gente integra e-commerce, POS, links de pagamento e outros canais em um único ecossistema, suportando diversos métodos e moedas ao redor do mundo. Com tecnologia flexível, APIs abertas e soluções altamente customizáveis, a Paybyrd permite que cada negócio crie a jornada de pagamento do seu jeito, aumentando taxa de aprovação, melhorando a experiência do cliente e dando visibilidade em tempo real sobre todos os pagamentos.


Principais Atividades

· Trazer padrões de arquitetura considerando escalabilidade, disponibilidade, resiliência, segurança e custos;

· Fazer entregas de alta qualidade utilizando boas práticas como clean code, testes, ci/cd, dry, solid e etc;

· Resolver os problemas de forma autónoma;

· Participar do crescimento técnico de outras pessoas da equipe;

· Colaborar com aequipe na resolução de bugs ou incidentes de alta complexidade quando necessário;

· Colaborar na tomada de decisão sobre a evolução do produto e da tecnologia.



Requisitos


Arquiteturas modernas focadas em escalabilidade, alta disponibilidade, resiliência, segurança e boas práticas de cloud (12-Factor, microsserviços, APIs bem definidas, etc.);

Desenvolvimento backend em .NET (.NET 6+ e .NET Framework) criando APIs REST, serviços de background e integrações com outros sistemas;

Desenvolvimento frontend com frameworks modernos (ex.: React/Angular), SPA, componentização, consumo de APIs, autenticação e gestão de estado;

Modelageme acesso a dados usando SQL Server (queries otimizadas, índices, procedures) e bancos NoSQL como Cosmos DB ;

Uso de cache distribuído com Redis para melhoria de performance, redução de latência e alívio de carga em serviços e bases de dados;

Integração assíncrona e desacoplada usando Azure Service Bus e outras soluções de mensageria em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;

Observabilidade e monitorização com ElasticSearch (logging estruturado, correlação de requests, dashboards, alertas e troubleshooting em produção);

Arquitetura orientada a eventos (event-driven), usando padrões como event sourcing, publish/subscribe e integração entre serviços;

Pipelinesde CI/CD no Azure DevOps , com build, testes automatizados, code quality, versionamento e deploy automatizado para diferentes ambientes;

Soluções em Azure (App Services, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, Application Insights, etc.), desenhando aplicações cloud-native e seguras;

Versionamento de código com Git , fluxo de trabalho com pull requests, code review, branching strategy (GitFlow/Trunk Based) e boas práticas de colaboração;

Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, testes de API), TDD/BDD quando aplicável, garantindo qualidade, segurança e manutenibilidade do código.


Diferenciais

· Ferramentas APM;

· Tunning.

description:

- Disponibilidadeem tempo integral (100% presencial);

- Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado

title: Risk Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

In SME credit, advantage compounds through disciplined underwriting, fast learning cycles, and early detection of risks. As our Credit Analyst, you will strengthen our underwriting edge by translating financial data, behavioural signals, and real-world borrower performance into precise credit decisions- while continuously feeding insights back into our core decision models.


Responsibilities

  • Conduct holistic credit analysis for SMEs: financials, cash-flows, tax compliance, bank data, concentration risks, behavioural signals.
  • Produce concise, decision-ready credit memos with recommendations (approve / adjust / decline).
  • Lead periodic reviews of high-exposure borrowers - liquidity evolution, leverage shifts, payment patterns, and macro impacts.
  • Evaluate and recommend credit-limit increases based on performance, updated financials, and risk appetite.
  • Maintain a closed-loop feedback mechanism between underwriting decisions and portfolio outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Data to translate recurring insights into better thresholds, features, and model logic.
  • Support portfolio monitoring with early-warning detection and risk-mitigation recommendations.
  • Ensure underwriting discipline and audit-ready documentation.


Qualifications

  • 2–3 years in IB, credit, structured credit, asset management, DCM or fintech underwriting.
  • Strong financial analysis: liquidity, leverage, coverage, working-capital dynamics, seasonality.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian tax reporting, accounting regimes, and corporate structures.
  • Experience writing clear, investor-grade credit memos.
  • Understanding of credit models (inputs, outputs, sensitivity) and ability to evaluate their strengths/weaknesses.
  • Bonus: exposure to securitisation, structured credit, data-driven underwriting.
  • High analytical rigor and precision in judgment.
  • “Manager of one”- delivers independently with consistency.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, both in English and Portuguese.
  • Proactive in identifying trends, risks, and model improvement opportunities.
  • Thrives in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment.
  • Passion for modernising Brazil’s B2B credit market through technology and transparency.
  • Integrity, long-term thinking, and intellectual honesty.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Itaim Bibi, Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Ejecutivo/A De Cuentas Y Operaciones Brazil
description:
Oportunidad profesional Latin Xplore Brasil !
Latin Xplore, agencia receptiva mayorista B2B y empresa hermana de Go West Tours (DMC USA), que tiene oficinas en Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Argentina, Brazil y Chile esta buscando su Ejecutivo de Cuentas y operaciones en nuestra oficina de Rio, Brasil.
Su misión va desde el establecimiento de itinerarios, la reelaboración de estos dentro de los presupuestos del cliente, la contratación, la facturación y la organización de los grupos y FITs, así como la asistencia en la organización de la A a la Z de los diferentes tours.
Puesto : Ejecutivo de Cuentas y Operaciones
Lugar: Bureau de Latin Xplore à Rio, Brasil
Descripción del Puesto
- Estar en contacto con los Tour Operadores, las agencias de viajes de Europa para responder a los pedidos de viajes y producciones para sus clientes
-Realizar cotizaciones de los viajes y elaboración de producciones
- Negociar con los proveedores para estar competitivos, mejorar las tarifas de compra y las márgenes, con la ayuda del Gerente General
-Desarrollar la facturación de la cartera de clientes: mantenimiento de relaciones con clientes existentes y desarollo con nuevos clientes, fidelizar, mantener el vínculo con las cuentas clave,
-Trabajo comercial con posible participación en ferias, seguimiento de los files, relanzas,
-Coordinación con de las operaciones. Cumplir, cuando sea necesario, con tareas de operación (reservar hoteles, guías, restaurantes, transfers, excursiones).
- Manejar las distintas herramientas de comercialización y trabajo : Travel Exchange, Toursys, Excel
Competencias Técnicas Requeridas:
 - Dominio Avanzado de Herramientas Informáticas: Excelente competencia en Microsoft Office, especialmente en Excel para cotizaciones, Word para la redacción de documentos. Canva sería una ventaja.
- Experiencia Profesional en Turismo: Experiencia significativa en una agencia de viajes o en una agencia receptiva, con una comprensión profunda de las operaciones y la logística del turismo, así como del mercado B2B.
- Conocimiento del Terreno de Brasil : Un conocimiento profundo de los principales destinos turísticos, las regulaciones locales y las particularidades culturales, lo cual es esencial para la elaboración de propuestas de viaje a medida. El conocimiento de otros países como Argentina puede ser también una ventaja.
Competencias sociales y personales:
 - Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad: Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios y gestionar eficazmente situaciones imprevistas, entusiasmo e inversión en una empresa en pleno crecimiento que coloca al ser humano en el centro de sus preocupaciones.
- Multitarea y gestión de la presión: Capacidad para gestionar simultáneamente varios proyectos y clientes mientras se cumplen plazos ajustados, garantizando una prestación de servicio eficiente y profesional.
- Competencias interpersonales y comunicación: Excelente habilidad para comunicarse, negociar y establecer relaciones duraderas con clientes y proveedores.
- Orientación al cliente: Compromiso para proporcionar un servicio al cliente excepcional, anticipar las necesidades de los clientes y proponer soluciones creativas y adaptadas. Rigor y sentido del detalle son cualidades que buscamos para estar lo más alineados posible con las especificaciones de nuestros clientes y nuestra carta de calidad.
Lo que ofrecemos:
 - Un salario competitivo basado en la experiencia
- Contrato local con beneficios complementarios
- Entorno de trabajo híbrido, combinando oficina y teletrabajo
- Participación en un proyecto innovador y en plena expansión, con un excelente ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de crecimiento
Para presentar su candidatura, envíe su CV y una carta de presentación a , especificando en qué medida su experiencia y aptitudes se ajustan a los requisitos de este puesto. Esperamos darle la bienvenida a nuestro equipo y hacer de nuestra colaboración un éxito conjunto.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Brunel apoia um cliente global do segmento de iGaming na busca por um(a) Electrical Engineer.

Buscamos um(a) profissional hands-on, com sólida experiência em sistemas elétricos, para atuar diretamente em operações técnicas de alta complexidade dentro do ambiente de iGaming, garantindo confiabilidade, segurança e continuidade operacional.


Responsabilidades

  • Análise técnica e troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e solucionar falhas em sistemas elétricos (distribuição, iluminação, controle).
  • Atuação em campo: Suporte presencial em instalações, garantindo configuração correta e funcionamento dos componentes.
  • Testes e comissionamento: Realizar testes, validar performance e corrigir inconsistências.
  • Documentação técnica: Elaborar e manter relatórios, especificações e manuais.
  • Compliance: Assegurar conformidade com normas (NEC, IEC, OSHA).
  • Integração multidisciplinar: Trabalhar com engenharia, projetos e demais stakeholders.
  • Suporte técnico em obras e integrações: Atuar com equipes internas e externas durante construção e implantação.
  • Melhoria contínua: Propor otimizações em processos e sistemas.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • 3–5 anos de experiência prática em engenharia elétrica e troubleshooting.
  • Conhecimentos em UPS, geradores, distribuição de energia, sistemas de controle e iluminação.
  • Familiaridade com normas IEC, IEEE e diretrizes de segurança.
  • Habilidade para cálculos elétricos (carga, queda de tensão etc.).
  • Inglês avançado.


Diferenciais

  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas.
  • Boa adaptação a ambientes dinâmicos e equipes multidisciplinares.

title: Editor De Vídeo

title: Gestor(A) De Portfólio De Produtos - Compras
description:
Com foco em inovação e excelência em nossas operações, buscamos profissionais apaixonados(as) pela área de compras, análise e negociação estratégica e gestão de categoria de produtos, para se juntar à nossa equipe e desfrutar de um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, desafiador e gratificante, que proporciona grandes oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.


Responsabilidades:


Gestão de itens comercializados pela empresa, gestão de fornecedores e contratos.


Responsável pelas métricas de medição: venda, margem e giro de estoque. Negociação com fornecedores de produtos, serviços e plataformas digitais. Classificação os produtos na pirâmide mercadológica. Aplicação e análise da matriz BCG - gerenciar o ciclo de maturação natural do portfólio de produtos e serviços - ciclo de vida. Identificar produtos potenciais e produtos a serem retirados ou substituídos do portfólio. Identificar mercado total, mercado disponível, nichos de mercado, cultura, hábitos, comportamento de consumo e concorrência. Definir a precificação dos produtos alinhada a estratégia da empresa.


Montar campanhas junto aos fornecedores para promover os produtos. Lançar promoções por linha de produto, grupo e ou canal de vendas. Desenvolver o canal e-commerce a partir das estratégias de gestão de portfólio. Atuar junto ao time de marketing para desenvolver o portfólio de produto e canais de vendas. Analisar estoque e definir parâmetros conforme ação, sazonalidade, etc. Planejar e gerir o investimento do estoque. Emitir ordens de compras e realizar follow-up.


Requisitos:


Para participar deste processo seletivo é importante possuir conhecimento em Excel (intermediário a avançado);
noções intermediárias de marketing;
técnicas de desenvolvimento de produtos e portfólio;
indicadores;
planejamento;
análise de dados;
gestão de estoque, pesquisa de mercado, mídias digitais, conhecimento da operação de e-commerce e marketplace, precificação e técnicas de mecânicas de preço.


Ser estratégico(a), possuir habilidade de negociação, foco nos resultados, com disposição para transformações e espírito de equipe.


Remuneração, benefícios e horário de trabalho:


Remuneração atrativa composta por salário fixo + VT + VR/VA + Assist. Médica + Assist. Odontológica + Seguro de Vida + Auxílio-Educação + Prêmio Assisuidade


Trabalho presencial (Porto Alegre), de segunda a sexta, horário comercial.

title: Quality Specialist
description:
Job Responsibilities:

1. Identify quality control points, develop and implement quality control plans, monitor and control product quality to ensure compliance with quality standards and customer requirements;

2. Participate in establishing and continuously improving the company's quality management system, organize and conduct internal training to enhance employees' quality awareness and skill levels, and promote the development of the company's quality culture;

3. Analyze and resolve quality issues arising during R&D and manufacturing, propose improvement measures to ensure product quality stability. Participate in new product design and development, establish quality standards and testing plans to ensure new products meet quality requirements;

3. Demonstrate resilience and adaptability to frontline work environments;

4. Exhibit strong ambition and accountability, continuously striving for self-improvement;

5. Possess keen insight to proactively identify and resolve issues.

Preferred Qualifications: Prior internship experience in manufacturing companies is advantageous.

Additionally, we seek candidates with strong service orientation and teamwork spirit, who are diligent, responsible, and committed to their duties.

title: Performance Development Specialist
description:
Job Responsibilities

1. Conduct testing and enhancement of product performance metrics and usage effectiveness, including technical research and development in areas such as thermal-humidity environment control, rapid cooling/heating, low-temperature heating performance, high-efficiency technologies, novel heat exchangers, and new refrigerants;

title: Senior Amlo
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a Senior AMLO to oversee the company’s global AML framework, with primary responsibility for Brazil. The role covers regulatory obligations under BCB, COAF, CVM, and frameworks for electronic money issuers, payment institutions, and related sectors. You will serve as the main regulatory contact and designated MLRO for Brazil.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the AML/CTF programme for Brazil, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations (BCB, COAF, CVM, PIX, EMI/payment frameworks).
  • Act as the official MLRO for Brazilian operations and support regulatory expectations in other jurisdictions as needed.
  • Develop and maintain AML/CTF policies, KYC/CDD/EDD standards, and ongoing monitoring frameworks tailored to Brazilian requirements (CPF, CNPJ, beneficial ownership rules).
  • Implement governance aligned with BCB/COAF/CVM supervisory standards.
  • Conduct AML risk assessments and manage monitoring systems for transaction surveillance, sanctions/PEP screening, and detection of local typologies (e.G., PIX fraud).
  • Ensure timely COAF reporting and all mandatory filings for payment institutions.
  • Maintain proper audit trails and records under Brazilian retention standards.
  • Serve as the primary contact for BCB, COAF, and CVM for AML-related matters.
  • Deliver AML/CTF training covering Brazilian typologies, COAF red flags, and sector-specific risks.
  • Ensure compliance with LGPD and manage cross-border data transfers lawfully.



Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business, or related field;
    Master’s preferred.
  • 10+ years of AML/CTF experience with deep knowledge of Brazilian AML laws and regulatory frameworks.
  • Proven experience in AML leadership within payment institutions, EMI, fintech, or regulated financial environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian PEP rules, ownership verification, PIX risk patterns, and reporting systems (SISCOAF, BCB platforms).
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working directly with Brazilian regulators.



Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.



Our Valued Behaviors


  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.



About Actabl's Product Design Team


We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.


Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out Actabl Design here .



Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.

  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.



You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile


You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.

title: Risk Management Manager
description:
As the Safety Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of safety risk

management at Keeta.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Lead data analysis and modeling for platform risk scenarios
  • Conduct risk identification, classification, and early-warning analysis across rider/driver/courier, merchant, and customer segments.
  • Perform bottom-up data discovery and metric construction
  • Conduct in-depth EDA using raw mobility/delivery platform data (orders, location traces, incentives, behavioral logs).
  • Build standardized risk metrics, operational metrics, behavior features, and monitoring indicators from the ground up.
  • Apply top-down business perspective to drive strategy and execution
  • Work closely with product, operations, policy, and risk teams to translate high-level business goals into measurable and actionable metrics.
  • Drive 0→1 metric system design for new markets or new products, and evolve metrics for rapid growth and later-stage refinement.
  • Develop dashboards and risk monitoring systems
  • Build and maintain BI dashboards to monitor key risk, quality, safety, and operational metrics.
  • Detect anomalies, conduct root-cause analysis, and support incident response and post-mortem reviews.
  • Support cross-functional decision making and risk strategy design
  • Provide data-driven insights to support risk mitigation strategies, counter-measure design, operational policy updates, and business optimization.
  • Evaluate the impact of policy or product changes, and create closed-loop measurement frameworks.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Research, Data Science, or related fields.


Technical Skills


  • Proficient in SQL and Python/R for data processing, modeling, and analysis.
  • Solid knowledge of machine learning methods (logistic regression, decision trees, anomaly detection, clustering) is preferred.
  • Strong ability to understand raw data structures and build robust metric definitions.
  • Risk Experience (Core Requirement)
  • Experience in risk analytics, trust & safety, fraud detection, operational risk, or platform governance—preferably in mobility, delivery, or other two-sided marketplace industries.
  • Familiar with risk assessment lifecycle: identification → quantification → monitoring → mitigation.
  • Bottom-Up Analytical Capability
  • Ability to investigate raw data (orders, trajectory data, incentives, cancellations, GPS signals, courier/driver behavior) and derive structured metrics and actionable insights.
  • Top-Down Business and Strategy Thinking
  • Ability to understand business models such as supply-demand balancing, delivery SLA, driver/courier incentives, merchant performance, and safety/quality frameworks.
  • Proven experience in designing and scaling 0→1→N metric systems supporting business objectives.
  • Project Experience (strong preferred but not necessary)
  • Experience supporting new market entry, new product launches, or rapid-scale operations is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical reasoning, structured communication, and data storytelling abilities.
  • Ability to convert complex analysis into clear, practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with high attention to detail.

description:
RESUMO DO CARGO


Essa pessoa será responsável por promover a cultura de melhoria contínua nas operações, garantindo a padronização dos processos conforme os padrões globais.

Entre suas principais atividades estão o suporte ao planejamento e execução de treinamentos Belt (Lean Six Sigma), a identificação e lançamento de projetos de melhoria de diferentes níveis de complexidade, e o acompanhamento da governança dos projetos entre as plantas. Também será responsável por desenvolver processos de gestão e garantir que o AMPS esteja integrado à rotina operacional das fábricas, assegurando consistência e entrega de resultados.

  2. Suportar o processo de planejamento, implementação e execução dos treinamentos de formação Belt, bem como o suporte na identificação e lançamento de novos projetos de baixa, média e alta complexidade, com o objetivo de garantir o alcance de resultados alinhados as metas da organização.
  3. Apoiar a coordenação corporativa do programa AMPS, por meio do acompanhamento da execução da implementação e governança dos Use Cases, com o objetivo de garantir o padrão de ferramentas e abordagens entre as plantas, aderência ao padrão global e entrega de resultados para a organização.
  4. Desenvolver e atuar em processos de governança e acompanhamento na gestão de ferramentas e processos do programa AMPS de forma a acompanhar sua implementação, incorporação da gestão de rotina das fábricas bem com aderência aos padrões.

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em:
  • Lean Manufacturing e Seis Sigma.
  • Gestão de Rotina.
  • Hoshin Kanri.

Sobre a Ardagh

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!


Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.


Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)
